reason: Chapter 86 'Toluene' of the cited `2007 - LCI chemicals - Althaus.pdf` is this dataset's chapter. Its inventory tables Tab. 86.4 (p.852), Tab. 86.5 and Tab. 86.6 are the cumulated PlasticsEurope vector of this very dataset, and sec. 86.6 says so: 'The production process for toluene was assessed with data from PlasticsEurope (Boustead (2005-07)) ... Due to the fact that this dataset is cumulated it was not possible to use the other processes modelled in econvent to obtain a transparent process chain.' The chapter does print real plant data from European Commission (2002) - Tab. 86.1 energy usage, Tab. 86.2 air emissions, Tab. 86.3 wastewater, Tab. 1.4 solid wastes - but they cannot be turned into a unit process for toluene: they are given 'per ton of feedstock' for a multi-product BTX plant whose toluene yield Tab. 86.1 prints as 'Toluene 0 - 0.3' tons per ton of feedstock (a range that includes zero, so it cannot be used as a divisor), alongside 'Benzene 0.12 - 0.24', with no allocation between the aromatics and no xylene yield to close a mass allocation; and sec. 86.5.3 states 'Little is given on toluene production alone as most information pertains to benzene or BTX production plants.' Per the rule that the cited report is not the only report that may document a dataset, all 114 bundled reports were converted with pdftotext and searched for an inventory of this dataset. No other bundled report models toluene production.
